description: This file defines the SearchForm class used in SuiteCRM for rendering and processing search forms in the user interface. It includes methods for setup, display, and generating SQL WHERE clauses based on user input. It handles integrating search definitions, populating fields from requests, and building dynamic search queries.

classes.name: SearchForm
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering, managing, and processing search forms within SuiteCRM. It supports setup, display, and SQL WHERE clause generation for searches, handling user input, and integrating with saved searches and search definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SearchForm instance with seed object, module info, options, and sets up tabs.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up search definitions, fields, view type, and custom tabs based on provided search definitions and current view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search form interface, incorporating tabs, saved searches, and layout options.

methods.name: getViewTab
methods.description: Determines the current view tab ('basic' or 'advanced') based on displayView.

methods.name: getSearchInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all user-defined search parameters as an array for external use.

methods.name: findFieldOptionValue
methods.description: Helper function to find a display value for a given search option key.

methods.name: getSearchInfoJson
methods.description: Returns the user search parameters as a JSON encoded string.

methods.name: getColumnsFilterData
methods.description: Returns filter information related to column display, if available.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets options for file location and other configuration parameters.

methods.name: locateFile
methods.description: Locates a file within possible search paths, prioritizing custom directories.

methods.name: displaySavedSearch
methods.description: Returns HTML for the saved search form, potentially as part of the search UI.

methods.name: displaySavedSearchSelect
methods.description: Returns HTML for the dropdown to select among saved searches.

methods.name: _displayTabs
methods.description: Generates HTML for JavaScript-driven tab interface, preserving selections for display.

methods.name: _build_field_defs
methods.description: Builds search field definitions based on layout, seed object, and search definitions, populating formData and fieldDefs.

methods.name: populateFromArray
methods.description: Populates searchFields from an array, supporting different search contexts.

methods.name: parseDateExpression
methods.description: Converts date expressions into SQL WHERE clauses.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Creates an SQL WHERE clause based on the populated searchFields, handling various data types, ranges, and operators for search filtering.
